pkgmetadata.longdescription: AnyEvent-based async HTTP/WebSocket server library used by all Proxmox VE Perl daemons (pveproxy, pvedaemon, spiceproxy). Provides PVE::APIServer::AnyEvent (the main server), formatters (JSON, HTML, Bootstrap) and WebSocket upgrade support.

use.flag: Install www-apps/bootstrap for the built-in HTML API browser formatter (development tool; not needed for normal pxvirt operation)
